# Custom Bedrock Extension

Config-driven Bedrock-compatible gateway extension for Pi.

## Purpose
Loads one or more custom Bedrock profiles from config and exposes each profile
as its own Pi provider. This allows multiple endpoints, tokens, and headers to
coexist at the same time.

## Config locations
- .pi/custom-bedrock/models.json
- ~/.pi/agent/custom-bedrock/models.json

Project config wins over user config.

## Value resolution
For `baseUrl`, `apiKey`, and headers, values can be:
- literal strings
- `{ "env": "VAR_NAME" }`
- `{ "command": "shell command" }`

## Built-in models
Defaults to latest global Claude Bedrock inference profile IDs:
- global.anthropic.claude-opus-4-6-v1
- global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6

## Key Components
- config.ts: Config loading, validation, resolution
- registration.ts: Per-profile provider registration
- stream.ts: Custom Bedrock Converse streaming implementation
- index.ts: Session startup integration and `/custom-bedrock-status`

## Tests
- config.test.ts: path precedence, value resolution, profile validation
- registration.test.ts: provider registration and status rendering
